item.veilreach.astral_sigil.tooltip: Use on a Moonwoven Frame to awaken a Hush Portal.
item.veilreach.astral_sigil.tooltip2: Your first path into Hushlands starts here.
item.veilreach.astral_sigil.fail_frame: The sigil only responds to a Moonwoven Frame.
item.veilreach.lunar_fiber.tooltip: A pale thread used in Hushlands crafting.
item.veilreach.mirror_ingot.tooltip: Forge Mirrorsteel gear from the spoils of Hushlands.
item.veilreach.starfragment.tooltip: A relic shard needed to assemble a Warden Sigil.
item.veilreach.sanctum_key.tooltip: Recovered from the Sunken Sanctum. One half of the final rite.
item.veilreach.cathedral_seal.tooltip: Recovered from Moonfall Cathedral. One half of the final rite.
item.veilreach.warden_sigil.tooltip: Present this at a Sealed Altar.
item.veilreach.warden_sigil.tooltip2: It will awaken the Hush Sovereign.
item.veilreach.hush_ward_charm.tooltip: Grants protection and sight within the silver hush.
item.veilreach.hush_ward_charm.use: The ward hushes the silver fog around you.
item.veilreach.sovereign_ward.tooltip: A stronger ward that turns the hush to your advantage.
item.veilreach.sovereign_ward.use: The Sovereign Ward hardens the hush around you.
message.veilreach.hushlands.hazard: The silver fog presses in. A Hush Ward Charm would steady your breath.
message.veilreach.fogbound_barrier.locke: A heavy veil seals the way. A Hush Ward Charm should steady it.
message.veilreach.fogbound_barrier.opene: The fogbound seal loosens and the passage opens.
message.veilreach.portal.invalid_frame: The sigil needs a complete Moonwoven Frame.
message.veilreach.portal.opened: The air parts. A gate to the Hushlands opens.
message.veilreach.sealed_altar.locked: A silent ward rejects you. The altar needs a Warden Sigil.
message.veilreach.sealed_altar.awakened: The seal breaks, and the Sovereign answers.
message.veilreach.starlight_cache.opened: A stash of starlit metal spills from the cache.
subtitle.veilreach.hushlands: The silver hush closes behind you.
